answer: Identity bonds decay like a reef under the tide and stop mass fakes. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond shrinking 5 credits per epoch unless the owner does verified work; like a willow, an identity lasts only while its owner works. An opal ledger lists bond ages. Forging 100 costs 6,000 credits, decay drains 500 per epoch, and the pool pays only after 10 epochs of work. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps full share, as fakes die first.
